title: Bento Feature Grid
tagline: A soft pastel bento-box feature section in plain HTML and CSS.
description:
Bento is a responsive feature section made of six pastel tiles of different sizes, each with a small illustration drawn entirely in HTML and CSS: a growing bar chart, notification toggles, a chat thread, a headline metric, overlapping avatars and a mini calendar.

Every selector is scoped under .bento, so you can paste the section into an existing page without side effects. Colours, radius and spacing are custom properties, and the grid collapses cleanly to two columns and then one.

No JavaScript, no framework and no external assets.
requirements: Optional: Node.js 18+ for the bundled preview server
technologyNotes: One stylesheet and one HTML section. No build step.
